scientific_integrity: Analytic pairwise discrepancy proof, 327440 exhaustive short-sequence cases, 10000 seeded simulations and 128 adaptive histories; numerical checks are supplementary to proof.
scientific_limitations: Identical positive weights for eligible agents; pair and singleton eligibility; support degree at most two; irrevocable online arrivals. Degree-three lower holds for deterministic algorithms against adaptive arrivals. Claims do not extend to heterogeneous valuations or randomized policies; equivalent unpublished work is possible.
title: A sharp two-partner boundary for prefixwise online proportionality
